captureMethod.renderer: Production PopoverController and footer controls; fixed owned backdrop
captureMethod.powerData: Fixed power/time/history/helper display fixtures, not live hardware readings
captureMethod.inputRoute: OS CGEvent.post through WindowServer and native tracking
captureMethod.footerROI: Requested directly from native WindowServer capture API, not cropped later
captureMethod.backdrop: Fresh owned full-screen backdrop after popup presentation, with separate native RGBA calibration
captureMethod.animation: Original native PNG IDAT streams packaged into APNG with actual inter-frame intervals; no pixel processing, generated frames or drawn pointer

hostedCI.releaseScope: Release-main and installer-candidate gates are separate; this gallery does not establish their completion.

VMDelayedCleanupAudit.scope: Owned QA applications, child processes, app registrations, test containers, preferences, mounts and exact owned TCC rows were cleared. The disposable VM remains idle for subsequent installer-candidate validation.

validation.scope: This gallery validates the recorded fixtures and input paths on the listed VM OS; it does not establish the reporter macOS 27.0.1 result or a release PKG hardware-battery test. Earlier diagnostic failures and raw frames remain private QA evidence.

reproduction.originalFrameSHA256AndTimestamps: Each animation verification JSON lists original native PNG SHA256, decoded RGBA SHA256, capture rectangle, actual OS pointer positions, original timestamps and APNG delay fractions. Original PNGs remain in the explicit private QA evidence.
reproduction.encodingValidation: ffmpeg 8.0.1 decoded each original sequence and APNG to RGBA framehash; all 37 ordered frame hashes match for every included animation. Timing error must be less than one microsecond.
